articles.summary: The responsible company has once again been recognized by the Women in Trucking Association Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, has been named by the Women in Trucking Association (WIT) as one of the Top Companies for Women to Work in Transportation for the eighth year in a row. Presented by Redefining the Road , WIT’s official magazine, the recognition honors companies for their work employing and retaining women in the trucking industry. Schneider was evaluated for its supportive company culture, competitive compensation and benefits, flexible work options, and commitment to professional development and career advancement. articles.summary: Company adds more instructor positions across key locations to increase training capacity while maintaining its reliable approach As supply chains continue to depend on a steady pipeline of drivers, Schneider is expanding its driver training by increasing instructor positions by 26%. The expansion reflects the carrier’s continued commitment to maintaining a strong training program while preparing the next generation of drivers. The additional roles will help more new hires move from onboarding to behind-the-wheel training while maintaining the company's longstanding focus on quality training. The new positions will be concentrated across Schneider’s nationwide network of training locations that support Schneider’s driver hiring and training efforts across the country.
